description: Atlyn Bullet Chart provides a compact KPI benchmark visual for Power BI. It compares actual performance with a target and qualitative ranges, replacing bulky gauges with dense, readable scorecards. The visual supports horizontal and vertical layouts, positive and negative values, targets and ranges, full and partial highlighting, multi-selection and cross-filtering, report-format-aware labels and tooltips, keyboard operation, Power BI themes, high contrast, and both empty-space and data-point context menus. Common uses include revenue and margin benchmarks, market-share targets, operational KPIs, service levels, and executive dashboard rows. The visual is free for personal and commercial use under the MIT License; no purchase, subscription, account, or license key is required.
